July rainfall boosts Mumbai reservoirs, global climate concerns highlighted

July rainfall significantly increased Mumbai's reservoir levels, reaching a three-year high despite a delayed monsoon. Analysis suggests West Pacific warming and western disturbances contributed to above-normal rainfall in the region. Concurrently, international reports highlight climate change's role in intensifying droughts in Europe and England, with scientists linking extreme weather events to global warming and carbon emissions. India faces climate change threats, with concerns raised about erratic monsoons affecting crop sowing and specific regions like Meghalaya experiencing significant rain deficits.
